name: spring-dock
title: Spring Dock
description: The indicator slides under the selected item.
useCases: In a layout editor, a designer picks a tool by its icon. The app maps the button index to a canvas tool.
In a creator workspace, a bottom dock opens the library, drafts and publications, highlighting the active section.
task: The indicator slides under the selected item.
behavior: Each item takes a label and a Lucide icon component. onChange reports the selected index. Construct the icon list in a client component.
